clauses.title: Indemnification
clauses.text: Vendor shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Customer against any third-party claims arising from Vendor's negligence, willful misconduct, or breach of Section 7 (Data Security), including reasonable attorneys' fees, except to the extent arising from Customer's unauthorized modifications or misuse of the Service.

clauses.title: Limitation of Liability
clauses.text: Except for breaches of Section 7, confidentiality obligations, or indemnification obligations under Section 8, neither party's aggregate liability shall exceed the fees paid or payable by Customer in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim. In no event shall either party be liable for indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages.

clauses.title: Termination for Convenience
clauses.text: Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon ninety (90) days' prior written notice. Customer shall pay all fees due through the effective date of termination and any non-cancellable commitments in active order forms.

clauses.title: Subprocessors
clauses.text: Processor may engage subprocessors listed at https://nimbus.example/legal/subprocessors. Processor shall provide thirty (30) days' notice before adding a new subprocessor; Controller may object on reasonable data-protection grounds.

clauses.title: Liability cap (Order Form)
clauses.text: Notwithstanding the MSA, total liability under this Order Form shall not exceed fees paid under this Order Form in the prior six (6) months.

clauses.title: Data Security
clauses.text: Vendor shall maintain administrative, technical, and physical safeguards designed to protect Customer Data against unauthorized access, use, or disclosure, consistent with SOC 2 Type II or equivalent standards.

clauses.title: Term and survival
clauses.text: Confidentiality obligations survive five (5) years from disclosure; trade secrets survive indefinitely. Neither party may use residuals learned without breaching this Agreement.

clauses.title: Acceptance criteria
clauses.text: Customer shall accept or reject deliverables within ten (10) business days of delivery. Silence constitutes acceptance unless deliverables fail materially stated acceptance tests.
